FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Proof rides along every trip and test with minimums staircasing thirty, sixty, fifteen across victims and property, minors borrowing parental coverage against adult self-coverage with licensed sellers only, and uninsured crashes trading four-year suspensions against certificate-backed comebacks and low-cost lifelines [A01].
Why it matters: group insurance; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F01, sec10-F02, sec10-F03, sec10-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0082]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A02
Crash causes rank human errors from distraction through off-pace speed with flasher sightings and clear roads as responses, at-scene duties stack stopping against hit-and-run terror plus nine-one-one triage and document swaps, and twenty-four-hour police reports plus parked-property notes and animal calls close the scene [A02].
Why it matters: group collisions; difficulty high; prereq sec10-R01; confusables sec10-F05, sec10-F06, sec10-F07, sec10-F08 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0083]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A03
DMV reporting fires on the thousand-dollar and any-injury triggers within ten days with every driver filing SR ones regardless of fault or pavement ownership, and records absorb every reported crash by driver duty alone [A03].
Why it matters: group reporting; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-R02; confusables sec10-F09, sec10-F10, sec10-F11 [A03].
